The '''Clysm system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="New Territories" /> It shared its name with the [[Clysm Fleet]].<ref name="DVatGP4">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 4|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 4]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Clysm system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square O-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
